STEP 10. Check for open circuit and harness damage 
between right bank heated oxygen sensor (rear) connector 
B-28 terminal 2 and ECM connector C-58 terminal 49 <M/T> 
or PCM connector C-55 terminal 57 <A/T>.
Q: Is the harness wire in good condition?
YES : Replace the ECM or PCM. Then go to Step 15.
NO : Repair it. Then go to Step 15.
STEP 11. Check connector C-62 at ECM <M/T> or 
connector C-59 at PCM <A/T> for damage.
Q: Is the connector in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 12.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection (P.00E-2). Then go to Step 15.
